name: get_pricing_analysis
description: Get pricing analysis for a SKU: current price, cost, margin, competitor prices (Amazon, Walmart, Target, Best Buy, Costco), market position, price elasticity, and recommended price.

name: optimize_pricing
description: Calculate optimal pricing for a SKU based on demand elasticity and a business objective. Returns recommended price with projected units, revenue, and margin impact.

objective.description: Pricing objective (One of: maximize_revenue, maximize_margin, competitive_match, clearance)

name: get_competitive_intelligence
description: Get competitive pricing intelligence across all monitored products: price position distribution, pricing opportunities (increase/match/clearance), and recent competitor moves.

name: get_margin_report
description: Get a margin analysis report by product category: gross/net margin, revenue, COGS, margin trend, and SKUs below target.
